registration.methodology: New independent user-authorized qa-targeted round. Fresh question-independent production extraction and organization for each development attempt; two real production QA entries; same deepseek-flash and frozen QASPER20/80. Same separated judge prompts, human gold and labels; anonymous paired grading against qa-calibrated-dev-v3 while preserving its historical original13/16. Actual QA cost separately compared to qa-efficient-dev-v2 (262191), not loosened by333357. At most four fresh20 attempts share1200requests/6M provider tokens; failed attempts remain immutable with complete recursive prior ledger. No automatic API retries, no best-of answer selection and no automatic budget extension. Full100 starts only after passing the fixed gate with identical tested source/binary/evaluation snapshot; full comparator is qa-efficient-full because no calibrated-full exists. Existing explicit parser/schema-only judge repair policy remains unchanged with all costs included. Same-model automatic fixed regressions, not unseen blind evaluation or completed human adjudication.
registration.snapshotPolicy: All previous raw artifacts/gates/registrations and source/evaluation snapshots remain immutable. Shared harness tag/budget dispatch may gain a new branch only after baseline backup; targeted evidence records its own complete file fingerprints. Historical fees are reported separately and added once to a cross-round aggregate, without deducting them from this independent new round limits.
